audience: insurance agencies that track producer licenses and carrier appointments in SureLC

useCases.title: Find expiring licenses and E&O policies
useCases.text: List the license records of all producers, then check a producer's E&O policies and read their expiry dates.

useCases.title: Check a producer's carrier appointments
useCases.text: Find a producer by NPN, then list the carrier appointments and filter them by status, such as terminated.

useCases.title: Review open appointment requests for a carrier
useCases.text: List the appointment requests of one producer for one carrier, then read the notes written on a request.

useCases.title: Review a firm's licenses and appointments
useCases.text: Look up a firm by its EIN, then list the firm's licenses and its carrier appointments.

useCases.title: Track a producer's training courses
useCases.text: List the training courses of one producer with their completion status, to see which courses are still open.
